items_flat.title_en: Eighth Circuit pauses Minnesota’s AI nudification ban in SpaceXAI appeal
items_flat.title_zh: 第八巡迴法院在SpaceXAI上訴期間暫緩明尼蘇達AI裸照禁令
items_flat.summary_en: Law360 reported that on Friday the Eighth Circuit granted SpaceXAI, formerly xAI, an injunction pending appeal, temporarily blocking enforcement of Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation ban on AI image nudification. A district judge had refused that relief in September. The appellate order reportedly gave no reasoning. Minnesota’s attorney general’s office said it would keep defending the law.
items_flat.summary_zh: Law360報導，第八巡迴上訴法院週五核准前身xAI的SpaceXAI「上訴期間禁制令」，暫時阻止明尼蘇達州執行全美首見的AI圖像裸化禁令。地院九月曾拒絕同樣救濟，上訴命令據報未附理由。州檢察長辦公室表示會繼續護法。
items_flat.analysis_en: The stay is procedural, not a ruling that the statute is unconstitutional, so Grok Imagine’s real-person image controls remain a live legal and product risk. What changes immediately is enforcement against the company while the appeal runs; scope beyond SpaceXAI is still unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是程序上的暫緩，不是認定該法違憲，Grok Imagine對真人圖像的控管仍是法律與產品風險。眼前改變的是上訴期間對該公司的執行；命令是否及於其他業者仍不清楚。
items_flat.quote: The Eighth Circuit has agreed to temporarily block Minnesota from enforcing its ban on image "nudification" technology while Elon Musk's SpaceXAI appeals a lower court's order leaving the ban in place.
items_flat.quote_zh: 第八巡迴法院同意，在Elon Musk的SpaceXAI上訴維持禁令的下級法院命令期間，暫時阻止明尼蘇達州執行其圖像「裸化」技術禁令。

items_flat.title_en: Meta open-sources Muse Gadgets so developers can build their own hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Meta開源Muse Gadgets，讓開發者自製硬體
items_flat.summary_en: Meta published open-source firmware and a Linux SDK so developers can connect Muse to boards such as ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, with example projects for e-ink displays and HDMI sticks. Nat Friedman said Meta also built Muse Home Link, a USB-C device for home-network devices, and is giving away 5,000 units to Muse subscribers in the US while supplies last.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta釋出開源韌體與Linux SDK，讓開發者把Muse接到ESP32、Raspberry Pi等板子，範例含電子紙與HDMI棒。Nat Friedman說公司也做了可接家用網路裝置的USB-C裝置Muse Home Link，並向美國Muse訂戶免費送出5,000台，送完為止。
items_flat.analysis_en: This pushes Muse from an app agent toward a hardware ecosystem without a new model. Whether DIY gadgets get the same permission and safety limits as first-party Muse devices is the open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把Muse從App代理推向硬體生態，不是新模型。自製裝置能否套用與官方裝置相同的權限與安全限制，仍是關鍵未知。
items_flat.quote: Muse gadgets are open source devices you build yourself.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse小裝置是你自己打造的開源裝置。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits $100 million to train 10,000 deployment engineers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic投入1億美元，目標訓練1萬名部署工程師
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy on October 2, backed by a $100 million commitment, to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The first program uses in-person instruction, a simulated enterprise deployment, and a 12-week residency. First cohorts include engineers from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, Novo Nordisk, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於10月2日推出Claude Frontier Academy，承諾投入1億美元，目標在2027年底前訓練1萬名Frontier Deployed Engineers。首個計畫含面授、模擬企業部署與12週駐點。首批學員來自Accenture、Bain、Capgemini、Deloitte、McKinsey、Morgan Stanley、Novo Nordisk與澳洲聯邦銀行。
items_flat.analysis_en: The bet is that enterprise adoption is constrained by deployment talent, not only model quality. Certification does not start until early 2027, so near-term revenue impact is unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 押注點是企業採用卡在部署人才，而不只是模型能力。認證要到2027年初才開始，短期營收效果尚未證實。
items_flat.quote: Today we are launching Claude Frontier Academy to solve one of the most pressing issues in AI implementation: talent.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Claude Frontier Academy，以解決AI落地最迫切的問題之一：人才。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes a production guide for the GPT-6 family
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-6系列生產環境指南
items_flat.summary_en: On October 2 OpenAI posted a practical guide for choosing among GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna. Listed API prices are $10/$50 per million input/output tokens for Astra, $2/$10 for Sol, and $0.10/$0.50 for Luna. The guide covers caching, compaction, reasoning effort, Ultrafast mode for Astra, and computer use.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月2日發布GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol與GPT-6 Luna的選型指南。列出的API價格為Astra每百萬輸入／輸出代幣10／50美元、Sol為2／10美元、Luna為0.10／0.50美元。內容涵蓋快取、壓縮、推理力度、Astra的Ultrafast模式與電腦操作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is routing advice, not a new model. It locks in a three-tier price ladder and tells builders to treat Sol as the default for coding and computer use rather than always calling Astra.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是路由建議，不是新模型。它把三層價格固定下來，並建議程式與電腦操作預設用Sol，而不是一律呼叫Astra。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 is our most advanced suite of models yet, and offers you a choice of models for different kinds of work.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6是我們迄今最先進的模型系列，並針對不同工作提供可選擇的模型。
